summary: REACH SUBSEA AS (org. no. 993 252 263) is a private limited company (AS) based in Haugesund, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2008-10-29. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 71.122 (Geologiske undersøkelser); it has 309 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 2.33 bn and net income was -NOK 64.5 m. CEO: Jostein Alendal; board chair: Arne Joa; auditor: PRICEWATERHOUSECOOPERS AS. Also: LEI 254900UES6TZH101T379, ultimate parent REACH SUBSEA ASA.
